'''Avery Poliak''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[March 2001 Las Vegas tournament (17 March)]] on 17 March 2001 with [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|COTVG]], according to Dan Christy's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1915">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-19-las-vegas-3-17-and-3-18d1915/ las-vegas-3-17-and-3-18], DeckTech (Dan "Mystikal" Christy, 19 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-19-las-vegas-3-17-and-3-18d1915/ GitHub Pages]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261026022944/https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-19-las-vegas-3-17-and-3-18d1915/ Internet Archive].</ref> He reached the [[Young Jedi]] World Championship final round of 12 at [[DecipherCon 2000]].<ref name="tr-d1317">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-10-info-brokers-dcon-day-one-reportd1317/ info-brokers-dcon-day-one-report], DeckTech (Tim "Info Broker" Guzman, 10 October 2000): "Avery Poliak, who plays YJ, and is good at it, in fact he ended up a finalist in that". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261026023124/https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-10-info-brokers-dcon-day-one-reportd1317/ Internet Archive].</ref>
